ops.text: ccx vcs stack restack on the git lane places its conflict workspace inside the branch worktree (<worktree>/conflict-<branch>[-N]); after resolving, ccx vcs stack continue run from that workspace records the resolution but then refuses to move the branch because the workspace itself is untracked work in the worktree, and run from the worktree refuses for the same reason; moving the workspace out with git worktree move before that first continue breaks the run (workspace gone, abort and re-run). Workaround: continue inside the workspace, git worktree move it outside, continue again from the worktree. Fix: put the workspace beside the worktree, or ignore it in the dirty check.
